title: Algorithm Plugin Input Arguments
description: A schema for algorithm plugin input arguments

class_names.title: Class Names
class_names.description: Names for every class according to their index of the model prediction (separated by commas)

aug_library.title: Augmentation Library Name
aug_library.description: Indicate the augmentation library to extract from

severity_before.title: Before Severity
severity_before.description: Indicate the extent of severity to compare to (before)

severity_after.title: After Severity
severity_after.description: Indicate the extent of severity to compare to (after)

severity_before_idx.title: Before Severity (integer)
severity_before_idx.description: Indicate the extent of severity to compare to (before, as integer index)

severity_after_idx.title: After Severity (integer)
severity_after_idx.description: Indicate the extent of severity to compare to (after, as integer index)
